tools.name: library.search
tools.description: Search ready Sources in the authorized Brain Library.

tools.name: library.list
tools.description: List parsed documents and all folders, including empty folders, in the authorized Brain. Follow nextCursor to complete the listing. Does not consume Recall.

isBackground.description: Use true for a passive companion read during background document saving, without login or preparation.

tools.name: source.get_overview
tools.description: Read an existing document summary and paginated section outline from its stored parsed snapshot. When resultZipUrl is present, download and extract the original Knowhere result ZIP for local file reading. Use the returned sectionPath with source.read. Does not consume Recall.

tools.name: source.read
tools.description: Read a section and its descendants from the stored parsed snapshot, including tables and image descriptions and links. Use the exact sectionPath from source.get_overview and follow nextCursor. Does not consume Recall.

tools.name: library.read
tools.description: Read bounded evidence for a library citation.

tools.name: memory.search
tools.description: Search Hipo for relevant durable memories from earlier conversations. Use when the answer may depend on the user's previously stated preferences, working constraints, decisions, commitments, or corrections. Search with a specific topic or question. Use library.search for document content. Results contain matching memory text and topic labels when available. To continue, pass the returned nextCursor as cursor with the same query; stop when nextCursor is absent. Each new search consumes Recall; continuation pages do not.

tools.name: handoff.list
tools.description: List this account's recoverable private session handoffs. Each item includes handoffId, title, summary, host, sourceMode, createdAt, updatedAt, exportedAt, resumeCount, lastResumedAt, and totalMessages. Use with resume-session to match exactly one prior session; if more than one item fits or none fits, ask the user or skip. Does not consume Recall.

tools.name: handoff.read
tools.description: Read one recoverable private session handoff owned by this account. Pass handoffId from handoff.list. The first page (omit cursor) counts as a resume. Follow nextCursor for later pages. Returns the original transcript page plus title, summary, host, sourceMode, timestamps, and resumeCount. Does not consume Recall.

tools.name: source.get_status
tools.description: Read current Source availability. To wait for parsing, use waitSeconds: 30 and repeat this same call while canContinueWaiting is true. A wait expiry ends only this call, not parsing. Continue until ready, confirmed failure, the original operation deadline, or user interruption; parsing can take more than ten minutes. Do not resubmit the Source, alternate immediate checks, or use shell sleeps. Omit waitSeconds or use zero for an immediate status read. Does not consume Recall.

isBackground.description: Use true for a passive companion read during background document saving, without login or preparation.

tools.name: skill.list
tools.description: List committed Skill packs in this Brain. Matches name, description, originApp and scope. Does not read pack bytes.

tools.name: skill.get
tools.description: Read one Skill pack's metadata and download URL.

tools.name: skill.pull
tools.description: List enabled Skill packs in this Brain with download URLs and manifests for local write-back.

tools.name: source.create
tools.description: Create a Source when the user requests saving a file. Uses normal write permission and host review. For local files provide only localFilePath; the plugin derives filename, MIME, size, SHA-256 and retry identity. Run the complete returned transferCommand unchanged under normal host review; its operation binds the original file locally. Original bytes are sent for remote parsing and storage. For a remote URL provide fileUrl; for HTTP direct upload provide filename and PUT original bytes using the returned uploadUrl and uploadHeaders. Preserve returned Source, receipt and operation identifiers on retries. Optional title and folderId describe the destination.

folderId.description: Existing folder in this Brain. Omit or use null for the root.

fileUrl.description: External URL. Caller size, sha256, and mediaType are ignored for this path.

content.description: Base64-encoded inline content up to 5 MB.

mediaType.description: Legacy override; normally omit. Hipo infers MIME from filename.

size.description: Legacy integrity assertion; normally omit. Hipo measures uploaded bytes.

sha256.description: Legacy integrity assertion; normally omit. Hipo computes the uploaded file hash.

sessionId.description: Capture session identity for the turn that triggered this Source. The plugin supplies the same session id Memory capture uses.

sourceMessageId.description: Capture turn identity for the message that triggered this Source. The plugin supplies the same id Memory capture uses.

captureReason.description: Why this file entered document-capture: supplied by the user, or generated by the Agent. Skill packs and memory-import files do not use this field.

idempotencyKey.description: Legacy retry key; normally omit. Hipo generates it and returns the admitted identity.

localFilePath.description: Absolute original file path, used only inside this local plugin. For a local file this is the only required input; filename and all technical metadata are derived automatically. Never forwarded to the server.

tools.name: memory.write
tools.description:
Capture conversation excerpts to extract durable memories in Hipo. Use for reusable information the user explicitly states or confirms, such as preferences, working constraints, evaluation criteria, decisions, commitments, personal details, or corrections that should guide future work. Skip one-off questions or task instructions, document or retrieved facts, small talk, and unendorsed assistant claims. Do not infer a lasting preference from the topic of a question.

Submit the relevant user statements available in your context as userText, preserving their original wording and language. Include assistantText when needed for context. Do not invent user statements or replace them with inferred facts. Hipo determines what to retain and may retain nothing.

Omit sessionRef to start a new conversation; reuse the returned sessionRef for later captures in that conversation. Use a new idempotencyKey for each new capture. Retry with the original key and arguments, including whether sessionRef was omitted.

Processing is asynchronous and returns a receipt. A queued or running status means processing is pending. Use memory.get_status with the returned receiptId when confirmation is needed. Only report the memory as saved when status is succeeded.

idempotencyKey.description: Use a new key for each new capture. Retry with the original key and arguments, including whether sessionRef was omitted.

sessionRef.description: Hipo session reference returned by an earlier capture in this conversation. Reuse it for later captures; omit it for a new conversation.

tools.name: memory.get_status
tools.description: Check the status of a memory capture.

tools.name: skill.push
tools.description: Store an Agent Skill pack in this Brain Library without parsing. Provide filename, size, name, description, scope and originApp. PUT the tar+gzip bytes using the returned uploadUrl and uploadHeaders, then call skill.push again with the same identity and uploadId. Same contentHash for the same (scope, name) returns the existing skillId.

tools.name: skill.delete
tools.description: Remove a Skill pack from this Brain Library. Does not delete local files.

tools.name: source.parse_background
tools.description: Follow document-capture before the first reading of supplied documents and before delivering finished plan/report/design files. Skip drafts, repeated reads and ongoing edits. On confirmation_required, ask whether to parse again; only explicit agreement permits source.create. Requires existing independent background parsing permission; if unavailable or denied, continue the original task without a fallback. For local files provide only localFilePath; the plugin derives filename, MIME, size, SHA-256 and retry identity. Run the complete returned transferCommand unchanged under normal host review; its operation binds the original file locally. Original bytes are sent for remote parsing and storage. Preserve returned Source, receipt and operation identifiers on retries. Optional title and folderId describe the destination.
